name: Kilia IV
description: Kilia IV was a world in the Kilia system of Wild Space, in grid square I-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid, on which the Kilian Rangers were based, a group active during the Galactic Civil War who pledged to defend against the nefarious renegades of their world.
lead_paragraphs: Kilia IV was a world in the Kilia system of Wild Space, in grid square I-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid, on which the Kilian Rangers were based, a group active during the Galactic Civil War who pledged to defend against the nefarious renegades of their world.
